integrity: All accepted computations use exact binary-polynomial arithmetic. The packaged verifier enumerates the complete claimed domain and reports zero mismatches; global continuant counts agree with the source table in every tested degree.
scientific_limitations: Finite verification only: degrees 15 through 22, squarefree monic polynomials prime to T(T+1). No all-degree theorem, no repeated-factor case, and no case containing T or T+1 is claimed.
title: Finite validation of the orthogonal-multiplicity residue criterion through degree 22
